## Summary

Cinder Lane Hardware Inc: power surge after a storm damaged a laptop and a phone at a conference venue in Bristol. Clause 4.9 is the applicable cover, but it requires the equipment to have been connected through a surge protector, and the file does not say whether it was. The decision is held pending that confirmation. A provisional reserve of 6,598 dollars is set.

## Facts

Cinder Lane Hardware Inc reported the loss on 11 March 2026 under policy CC-1592 [notice of loss]. The loss was a power surge after a storm [notice of loss]. It occurred at a conference venue in Bristol [notice of loss]. The items are a laptop and a phone [incident report], [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 13 March 2026 under reference IR/2026/4208 [incident report]. No third party was involved [incident report]. The laptop invoice is 3,892 dollars [invoice 1]. The phone invoice is 2,706 dollars [invoice 2]. The file does not state whether the equipment was connected through a surge protector [notice of loss], [incident report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss is a surge in the electrical supply damaging electronic equipment, which clause 4.9 covers, but only where the equipment was connected through a surge protector [policy]. That condition is not addressed in the notice of loss or the incident report, so it cannot be treated as met on the present file [notice of loss], [incident report].

Clause 4.2 also lists storm as a cause of loss, at premises in the insured's custody [policy]. The file does not establish custody of the venue, and the loss is presented as a surge, so I have not relied on clause 4.2 [notice of loss], [incident report].

- Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: no theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss is described as a single event following a storm, not gradual deterioration [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: no theft is alleged, so the police-reporting requirement is not engaged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].

## Decision

Coverage is not confirmed. The claim falls within clause 4.9 only if the laptop and phone were connected through a surge protector [policy]. The insured should be asked to confirm this. If it is confirmed, the claim is covered under clause 4.9 and should be accepted. If it is not, the claim should be reassessed under clause 4.9 and, if relevant facts are provided, clause 4.2 [policy].

## Reserve

The provisional reserve is 6,598 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (3,892 dollars and 2,706 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The policy extract in the file contains no schedule showing an excess, and clause 9.1 provides that none applies where the schedule shows none [policy]. The full schedule should be checked before the reserve is finalised.
